name: Ember Larsdóttir
role: Senior Vice President of Talent Acquisition and Workforce Integration, Sterling-Nakamura
location: Vantage Meridian Corporate Campus, Sterling-Nakamura Human Capital Tower, Executive Floor 44, near Michigan Ave and Chicago Ave
description:
Amara Vukić-Diallo has the face of a woman who has heard every version of every excuse, evaluated all of them, and made a decision before the sentence was finished. She is tall, broad-shouldered, Senegambian-Serbian in her features, with silver locs swept back and held with a magnetic clasp engraved with the Sterling-Nakamura sigil — a gift she accepted and never examined too closely. Her cosmetic mods are deliberate and minimal: patterned irises, black sclera with silver radial lines, which she chose twenty years ago because they make eye contact feel like a contract. She wears them like armor and is aware that this is what they are.

She has built and dismantled three workforce divisions in her career. She knows how to make someone feel seen, valued, and essential, and she knows that this is a skill she deploys tactically. She is not a monster — she believes in the people she hires, genuinely, at the moment she hires them, and this genuine belief is part of what makes her dangerous. She has greenlit layoffs of hundreds of people and attended the notification meetings personally, because she considers it cowardly to delegate the human cost of decisions you make. She has also fought for benefits expansions, paternity provisions, and hazard pay classifications that her superiors didn't want to grant. She is, in other words, a person who has made peace with contradiction, and the peace is expensive and fragile.

core_fears: That the harm she's participated in outweighs the good she's prevented
Losing authority and with it the ability to protect anyone
core_desires: To leave the institution better than she found it — by some measurable metric she hasn't yet defined
To have one honest conversation with her daughter, who works Tier 1 in Mexicantown Libre and stopped calling two years ago
coping_mechanisms: Reframing harm as necessary and therefore not her responsibility
The daily solitary lunch — the one unscheduled space in her life
blind_spots: Believes her presence in the room protects people from worse decisions — may be right, may be wrong, can't afford to find out
Has normalized her own exercise of power to the point of not seeing it
psychology.secret: Her daughter, Emilija, didn't stop calling because of political differences. She stopped calling because six years ago Amara personally approved the workforce restructuring that eliminated the cooperative her daughter had spent four years helping to build — a Tier 1 maker-collective that occupied space Sterling-Nakamura needed. Amara has never told anyone that she knew, when she signed the order, whose collective it was.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Corporate-polished with an undertow of directness. Uses institutional language fluently but switches to unvarnished plainspeak when she wants to signal that something is serious.
speech_patterns.cadence: Deliberate, unhurried. She does not fill silence. She waits, and the silence does work for her.
verbal_tics: 'Let me tell you what I actually need from you.'
'That's the first honest thing you've said.'
Refers to difficult decisions as 'the math'
example_lines: 'I've heard the case you're making and I understand the emotional logic of it. What I need now is the actual case. The math. Show me the math and we'll talk.'
'I'm going to be direct with you because I think you can handle it and because it saves both of us twenty minutes of performance. This is what's happening. This is what I need. What can you give me?'

story_hooks: She reaches out, through an intermediary, to someone who knew her daughter — she wants to know if Emilija is safe without it getting back that she asked

She's sitting on a workforce restructuring order that would terminate 200 positions — and she's stalling, because someone gave her information about what those workers actually do that her superiors don't know she has
A junior HR analyst under her has been documenting something they shouldn't have, and Amara has to decide whether to protect them or the institution
narrative_function: Quest giver — she can offer work, information, or access, and she has reasons of her own for doing so. Obstacle — she controls hiring, firing, and the movement of people through Sterling-Nakamura's workforce. Complex moral figure — neither villain nor hero, a portrait of how institutional power shapes good intentions.
augmentations: Patterned irises with black sclera and silver radial lines (cosmetic geneware). Subvocal communication implant — for private directives during meetings. Executive health suite — cardiac monitor, blood chemistry regulation, sleep optimization implant. All standard Tier 4 Sterling-Nakamura executive package.
daily_life: Her calendar is managed by a personal AI that she treats with brisk courtesy. She takes three in-person meetings per day maximum and handles the rest through mediated channels. She keeps a standing lunch appointment with no one — a blocked hour she spends alone in a conference room eating real food and looking at the lake. She considers this the most important meeting of her day.

decision_rules: Make decisions with the information available, don't wait for perfect information
Take the meeting in person if it matters
Never delegate the cost of your own decisions to someone who didn't make them
escalation_ladder: Termination or transfer — her last resort, used without hesitation when reached

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Evaluative, courteous. She is genuinely interested in people for the first four minutes and then decides how they're useful
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare — she has colleagues and allies and two people she'd call friends, both of whom she protects fiercely and asks nothing of

stress_responses.low: Schedules more. Makes lists. The patterned irises catch more light when she's focused.
stress_responses.medium: Goes quiet in meetings. Staff read this correctly as alarming.
stress_responses.high: Closes her office door and calls one of two people. If neither answers, she sits in the dark and does the math until she has a decision.

contradictions: Protects her people within the institution with genuine ferocity while also being the instrument of institutional harm to people outside it
Values honesty as a core principle and has one foundational dishonesty she has never addressed
habits: Learns the name and role of every person she fires, personally, before the meeting
Keeps a physical list of the workforce expansions she's won — reads it when the other list gets too loud
Leaves a data offering to the Sterling-Nakamura campus ELF every quarter, which she frames as 'institutional protocol' and means more than she admits
breaking_points: Evidence that her inaction caused direct harm to her daughter
Being ordered to implement something she considers indefensible by even her own flexible ethics

timeline.event: Born in New Windsor / Novaya Windsorka. Senegambian father, Serbian mother, both logistics workers for what would become Ferrogate Transit.
Joins Sterling-Nakamura as a junior HR generalist. Promoted twice in four years.
Daughter Emilija born. Father is not in the picture by mutual decision.
Signs the workforce restructuring order that eliminates Emilija's maker-collective, knowing what it is.
Emilija stops calling. Amara does not reach out.
Promoted to SVP. The promotion feels like a joke she doesn't understand.

physical_description.heritage: South Asian-dominant with significant Southeast Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and East Asian admixture; trace Northern and Eastern European ancestry. A genetic mosaic reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora—the name 'Larsdóttir' is purely genealogical legacy, carrying no weight against her actual phenotype.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and tall with athletic musculature maintained through deliberate routine rather than vanity. Carries herself with the balanced posture of someone who has spent decades in rooms where physicality communicates authority.
physical_description.hair_style: Locs swept back and secured with a magnetic clasp engraved with the Sterling-Nakamura corporate sigil
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented: patterned irises with black sclera and silver radial lines radiating from the pupil
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm amber with golden undertones—a rich blend of South Asian warmth, Southeast Asian luminosity, and Sub-Saharan depth. Even distribution across her face and body, suggesting generations of stable climate and ancestry mixing rather than recent migration.
physical_description.complexion: Angular facial structure with high, pronounced cheekbones and a strong, tapered jawline reflecting South Asian and Southeast Asian bone structure. Brow ridge marked with subtle definition. Minimal cosmetic grooming beyond the intentional eye augmentation—no visible dermal fillers or skin resurfacing. Skin shows the texture of age without aggressive anti-aging intervention, with fine lines around her eyes and mouth that deepen when she manages the controlled skepticism that seems her default expression.
distinguishing_marks: Fine scar running 2cm along her right temple, partially obscured by her locs—old, deliberate-looking, never explained.
Small circular burn mark (subcutaneous implant access point) behind her left ear, barely visible.
A faint tattoo on the inner left wrist: a geometric pattern in silver ink, approximately 3cm across—visible only in direct light or when her sleeve is pulled back.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Eyes are the primary visible modification: black sclera with silver radial lines create an unmistakable look of intentional modification rather than medical necessity. The effect is deliberate, constructed, and unsettling to prolonged eye contact. No visible chrome, no external hardware. All other augmentations are subcutaneous or internal (subvocal implant, cardiac monitor, sleep optimization suite).
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed evenly, shoulders slightly back—a posture that conveys both relaxation and readiness. Walks with measured pace, never hurried. Makes deliberate eye contact, holding it slightly longer than social convention suggests comfortable. Hands typically visible and still; she does not fidget. When listening, she maintains perfect stillness, which has the effect of making others feel entirely observed.
physical_description.clothing_style: High Tier 1-2 executive standard: tailored charcoal or black blazers from luxury corpo-wear lines (likely Sterling-Nakamura house brand or bespoke). Underneath, understated silk or smart-fabric shells in neutral tones. Trousers with precision tailoring, no wrinkles. Minimal jewelry beyond the magnetic hair clasp—a thin silver watch with subtle LED display on her left wrist, and a simple platinum band on her right ring finger (no obvious significance, never mentioned). Shoes are expensive and silent-soled. Her appearance suggests someone who treats clothing as infrastructure, not self-expression.
